shared_or_similar_visual_information: A filled portion bounded partly by a circular arc.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A selected plane region distinguished by shading within a geometric construction. Right image: A sector of a pie chart whose proportion encodes a labeled category’s share of the total.
Rationales: The geometry fill identifies a region through its arcs and other boundaries. The pie chart fill is keyed to a category and its fraction of a whole.
